newsitem.title: GREECE: SWITCH INTO BLUE CHIPS, INDEX GREEK STOCKS- OMEGA.
newsitem.headline: SWITCH INTO BLUE CHIPS, INDEX GREEK STOCKS- OMEGA.

text.p: Investors should liquidate their short-term positions in stocks not included in the Athens bourse's benchmark index in favour of blue chips and index stocks, said Omega Securities in a technical analysis report.
"Small-caps and other stocks not included in the general index should be relinquished immediately, switching into blue chips which will outperform the likely medium-term upswing," said Omega.
"Short-term plays in index stocks should be liquidated as the index approaches 1,650 points and a correction down to 1,570 points appears plausible," it added.
The 1,650 points were seen constituting a major resistance level at current low trading volumes and was not expected to be penetrated upwards immediately.
"Prices may accumulate during the index's rise from 1,530 points up to 1,650 as a breakout to higher index levels requires higher trading volume," it said.
Short-term indicators were signalling an oversold market up to around 1,650 points.

"This area is also crossed by a medium trend line which will emerge as a strong medium-term resistance level that will not be penetrated through immediately," it said. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
